prompts: I have several Obsidian vaults and overlapping research folders. Design one vault without creating an overcomplicated PARA clone and plan the migration safely.
My Telegram gateway, plugins, and manual notes all need to coexist. Define stable note schemas and an inbox boundary so each automation does not invent folders.
I want to rename and restructure thousands of notes with frontmatter changes. Preserve links and make the migration reversible.
